name: Azilal

info.best_time_val: Abr–Oct para senderismo · cascadas todo el año

overview.title: Bienvenido a Azilal — naturaleza del Alto Atlas, cascadas y valles históricos
overview.p1: Azilal se asienta en el Alto Atlas central de Marruecos, con gargantas profundas, picos nevados, valles en terraza y maravillas geológicas UNESCO.
overview.p2: Alberga las famosas cascadas de Ouzoud, Ait Bouguemez (Valle Feliz), el lago turquesa Bin el Ouidane y huellas de dinosaurios.

places.title: Qué ver en Azilal
places.subtitle: Cascadas majestuosas, valles y sitios geológicos.

ouzoud.title: Cascadas de Ouzoud
ouzoud.desc: La mejor cascada de Marruecos (110 m), pozas y macacos bereberes.

bouguemez.title: Ait Bouguemez (Valle Feliz)
bouguemez.desc: Valle verde de pueblos amazigh, manzanos y senderos.

demnate.title: Puente natural Imi n'Ifri
demnate.desc: Puente de roca natural cerca de Demnate.

cathedral.title: Roca Catedral (Anrgui)
cathedral.desc: Formación masiva como una catedral de montaña.

museum.title: Museo del Geoparque M'Goun
museum.desc: Museo moderno en Azilal con dinosaurios y fósiles.

zaouia.title: Zaouia Ahansal
zaouia.desc: Santuario espiritual y graneros de piedra.

stays.title: Where to stay in Azilal and the Atlas
stays.subtitle: From mountain guesthouses in Ait Bouguemez to lakeside resorts and falls lodges.

card1.name: Hotel Chems Le Lac
card1.desc: Resort hotel overlooking turquoise Bin el Ouidane with outdoor pool and water activities.

card2.name: Dar Itrane (Bouguemez)
card2.desc: Eco-lodge in the Happy Valley with Amazigh hospitality, home cooking and mountain guides.

card3.name: Riad Cascade Ouzoud
card3.desc: Quiet guesthouse minutes from Ouzoud Falls with garden and mountain views.

card4.name: Hotel Azilal Center
card4.desc: Comfortable town hotel for exploring the geopark museum and mountain routes.

booking_banner.title: Explore all stays in Azilal & Ouzoud
booking_banner.desc: Compare real-time rates, read verified reviews and enjoy free cancellation on most guesthouses and hotels.

eat.title: Where to eat in Azilal & Ouzoud
eat.subtitle: Terrace restaurants by the falls, Amazigh tagines and honey tasting.

ouzoud.title: Falls viewpoint terraces
ouzoud.desc: Riverside tagines and fresh orange juice with cascade views.

bouguemez.title: Mountain guesthouse meals
bouguemez.desc: Handmade couscous, garden vegetables and Amazigh bread from clay ovens.

lakeside.title: Lakeside restaurants
lakeside.desc: Grills and lake fish on sunny terraces overlooking the reservoir.

tips.title: Practical tips for Azilal and the High Atlas

transport.title: Getting around
transport.desc: Renting a 4x4 or car from Marrakech is best for mountain passes, Ouzoud and Ait Bouguemez roads.

bargain.title: Mountain weather
bargain.desc: High Atlas weather changes fast. Even in spring, nights are chilly — pack warm layers and sturdy boots.

water.title: Guides & culture
water.desc: A local mountain guide in Ait Bouguemez enriches hikes; carry cash as ATMs are scarce in remote valleys.

daytrips.title: Best day trips from Azilal
daytrips.subtitle: Surrounding gorges, lakes and imperial cities.

marrakech.title: Marrakech (2.5 hrs)
marrakech.desc: Connect easily to the medina and palaces of Marrakech.

benimellal.title: Beni Mellal & Ain Asserdoune (1 hr)
benimellal.desc: Historic spring garden and fortress over the Tadla plain.

imilchil.title: Imilchil Lakes (scenic drive)
imilchil.desc: Drive high plateaus to the twin lakes of Isli and Tislit.

q1.question: ¿Cuántos días en Azilal?
q1.answer: Tres a cuatro días son ideales para Ouzoud, Ait Bouguemez y Bin el Ouidane.

q3.question: ¿Se pueden ver huellas de dinosaurios?
q3.answer: Sí — Azilal forma parte del Geoparque mundial M'Goun UNESCO.

q4.question: ¿Cómo llegar a Azilal?
q4.answer: Por carretera en unas 2,5 h desde Marrakech o 1 h desde Beni Mellal.
